text:
Marie (Revenue Ops): quick preview for folks owning billing docs: new 'grace window' + adaptive credit pool going live soon. please skim and flag concerns.

Dan (Billing): TL;DR: 72-hour rolling grace window for short spikes + unused free credits flow into an adaptive pool applied against overages. invoices will show a new line item 'grace-adjustment' for transparency.

Sam (Engineering): dev note: webhook/usage export adds `grace_applied: true|false` and `reconciled_tokens`. example: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/accounts/:id/usage?reconcile=1"

Ashley (Support): support playbook ready. escalate manual reversal requests with tag `billing-grace` and include timestamps. templates in #support-templates.

Priya (Finance): timeline: internal alpha -> beta opt-in 2026-04-15 -> full rollout 2026-05-01. Dedicated/reserved contracts unchanged unless negotiated. reconciliations are GAAP-audited.

billing-bot: Console will show a 14-day banner and invoice CSV adds columns: raw_usage, grace_adjustment, billed_usage, pool_credit.

Marie (Revenue Ops): Links: internal doc -> /docs/internal/billing/grace-window.md ; rollout PR -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/billing/pull/540 . Please review by EOD Wednesday. Thanks! :sparkles:
